request: 为 Windows 桌面端实现与 macOS 相当的全局前台窗口截图到 Aide 草稿能力；配置全局快捷键、权限反馈、应用/窗口/时间上下文、会话隔离；不自动发送，独立 Issue/文档/测试/PR，不合并。
initial_status: Topic branch rebased onto main ba46ce28; pushed as PR #923 head 12d95a3b438037638a8e1411e88458edd6f55ae2.
acceptance: Windows Aide desktop exposes an opt-in configurable global modifier gesture with actionable permission/listening status.
A clean double modifier gesture captures only the current foreground application window and includes app name, window title and timestamp context.
Single/long press, intervening key or mouse, lock/hidden window and Aide itself do not trigger/attach.
One-time capture ticket binds image+context to the active unlocked Aide session and draft only; never sends automatically.
Windows CI and real Windows desktop acceptance pass; macOS/Linux behavior remains unchanged; topic docs and separate PR are ready; keep PR unmerged and close issue only after acceptance.
scope: internal/server/web/desktop-capture.js shared contract only if required

requirements.summary: Mac global app capture is shipped and Windows launcher lacks AideNativeCapture.
evidence: native/macos-desktop/main.swift: injected AideNativeCapture and foreground capture

design.summary: Use a dedicated global low-level keyboard/mouse listener and the existing one-use ticket/draft contract. Windows has no macOS-style Accessibility/Screen Recording permission prompts for this unpackaged desktop bridge. The implementation now prefers Windows.Graphics.Capture HWND interop on supported Windows versions, with bounded PNG dimensions, a 1.8-second frame wait, and a legacy PrintWindow fallback. GPU capture quality remains unaccepted until the GPU pixel fixture and an interactive Windows foreground app pass.
evidence: Microsoft Learn: IGraphicsCaptureItemInterop::CreateForWindow supports HWND capture from Windows 10 1903: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/windows.graphics.capture.interop/nf-windows-graphics-capture-interop-igraphicscaptureiteminterop-createforwindow
Microsoft Learn: PrintWindow asks the target app to render synchronously and may block: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/desktop/api/winuser/nf-winuser-printwindow
Current Windows desktop's ComputerBridge uses PrintWindow, so hardware-accelerated-window quality remains an explicit acceptance risk; it is not accepted as the final screenshot path

implementation.summary: Added opt-in global low-level keyboard/mouse hooks, persistent Shift/Ctrl choice, Windows AideNativeCapture message channel, host foreground-HWND validation, background screenshot worker, and one-time ticket delivery through shared draft API. Reused existing English catalog keys for the browser-only fallback and Windows permission status; added user-guide setup steps. Current screenshot implementation still uses PrintWindow and is not accepted as parity quality.
